description: This file contains utility functions for generating JavaScript code used in the user interface of the Employees module in SuiteCRM. It includes functions for validation of form data and setting UI components such as display tabs.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to validate employee record form data, checking required fields and email format.

methods.name: get_chooser_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to handle display tab selection in the employee form.
